sloka: इत्युक्तः स तु तारेयो रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ।जगामाकाशमाविश्य मूर्तिमानिव हव्यवाट् ।। ६.४१.७२ ।।।।
transliteration: ityuktaḥ sa tu tāreyo rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā ।jagāmākāśamāviśya mūrtimāniva havyavāṭ ।। 6.41.72 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Ravana! You have no control over your mind, and if you come in the range of my eyesight and enter the three worlds also you will not go alive again."
